card.name: Pregnancy and preterm birth reference text
card.fires_on: Commas, list words and name parts inside obstetric references: author lists in pregnancy citations and the preterm birth classification by weeks. Also fetal-harm wording in pregnancy warnings.

modes.label: Citation author lists
modes.description: Commas between author names in an obstetrics textbook citation.
modes.example: Cunningham FG, Gilstrap LC, Gant NF, Hauth JC<<,>> Leveno KJ, Wenstrom

modes.label: Preterm birth categories
modes.description: Punctuation, numbers and linking words in the list of preterm birth subtypes by gestational weeks.

modes.description: Words in pregnancy warnings about fetal harm or the mother.
modes.example: unless it is considered lifesaving for the mother. F<<etal>> testing may be appropriate

card.writes: It suppresses the word mother in several languages, so it discourages naming the mother next.
card.plain: It fires in pregnancy and preterm birth text, especially on commas in citation lists and in week-range lists.
